Preserved existing Kernel, Unified State, Human Surface, Runtime, Executor, Reviewer, correction, transport, publication, and downstream pin semantics behaviorally unchanged, with all mutations strictly confined to the three authorized files.

Added focused deterministic offline tests in tests/test_brain_sync.py covering single-NEXT rehydration, completed track, missing roadmap, ambiguous NEXT, unauthored NEXT, conflict detection, and strictly read-only execution with zero unresolved items and no network or model dependency.
